title: OpenStage offices and workplaces, set 1
description: Fifty-eight empty places to set a scene in: open-plan offices, private offices, meeting and training rooms, reception areas, lobbies, corridors, kitchens, supply rooms, server rooms, parking garages and outdoor entrances. None has anyone in it, so the people from the character packs can stand in them. The pictures were made with an AI picture service from written descriptions.

backgrounds.name: Open-plan office, long desks and a window wall
backgrounds.alt: An empty open-plan office in daylight: two long rows of pale wooden desks with computers and black chairs, a gray carpet, a window wall on the right and a wooden cabinet with a water cooler on the left.

backgrounds.name: Open-plan office, wood floor and a large plant

backgrounds.name: Open-plan office, desks along the windows

backgrounds.name: Corner office at dusk
